optimized_sql:
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc, 1, 20) AS reason_desc,
    AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash,
    AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_fee
FROM 
    web_sales
JOIN 
    web_returns ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk 
    AND web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
JOIN 
    web_page ON web_sales.ws_web_page_sk = web_page.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN 
    customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN 
    date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN 
    reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = web_returns.wr_reason_sk
JOIN 
    customer_demographics AS cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN 
    customer_demographics AS cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = web_returns.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
WHERE 
    date_dim.d_year = 1998
    AND (
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' 
         AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
         AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 
         AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status 
         AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status)
        OR
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' 
         AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' 
         AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 
         AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status 
         AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status)
        OR
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' 
         AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' 
         AND web_sales.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 
         AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status 
         AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status)
    )
    AND (
        (customer_address.ca_country = 'United States' 
         AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') 
         AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
        OR
        (customer_address.ca_country = 'United States' 
         AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') 
         AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
        OR
        (customer_address.ca_country = 'United States' 
         AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') 
         AND web_sales.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    )
GROUP BY 
    r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 
    reason_desc, 
    avg_quantity, 
    avg_refunded_cash, 
    avg_fee
LIMIT 100
